name: gen1recomp
tagline: A native Lua / LÖVE2D recreation of Gen 1 Pokémon
description: gen1recomp is a native Lua/LÖVE2D recreation of the first-generation Pokémon games, rebuilt from the ground up rather than emulated. The project reimplements the Gen 1 experience in a modern engine, making it portable, moddable, and easier to study than the original binaries. It targets retro fans, game developers, and anyone curious about how classic game systems actually work.
highlights: Native recreation in Lua/LÖVE2D instead of an emulator
A study-worthy reimplementation of classic Gen 1 systems
2.7k stars with an engaged retro-gaming community
curatorNote: Recompilation projects are having a moment, but this one goes further: a full native reimplementation in an open engine. For retro fans it is pure gold, and for developers it is a readable, moddable dissection of a legendary game.
